messages:
paul-support: customer ACME hitting 400 on /v1/responses (OpenAI-compat) for tool calling. They say it worked before integration change. Posting minimal repro they sent.

paul-support: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{
    "model": "rwd-openai-compat",
    "input": "Create item",
    "tool_calls": [
      {
        "name": "inventory_tool",
        "arguments": {
          "mode": "create_item",
          "sku": "12345"
        }
      }
    ]
  }'
```

paul-support: Response from our API (400): `tool arguments failed schema validation: enum mismatch at /tool_calls/0/arguments/mode`

maria-support: @paul-support thanks — can you paste the exact error blob from our logs (correlation id)? Also which customer org and which deployment (hosted vs dedicated)?

paul-support: correlation: 6f2a9c11, org: acme-inc, hosted-prod. Error log: `ValidationError: value "create_item" not in enum [create, update, delete] at arguments.mode`

devin-ml: looks like the customer's client is sending OpenAI-style toolcall but with a different enum variant (`create_item`). We normalize a few aliases, but this one isn't mapped. We changed enum strictness in runtime v2.3 to enforce smaller surface area.

maria-support: any recent rollout that could have tightened validation? @ops-sre

ops-sre: rolled out inference runtime v2.3 yesterday (canary->prod). It included stricter JSON schema for tool arguments (we rejected unknown enum aliases to avoid silent misrouting). We have a runbook entry that suggests a compatibility flag for orgs who need alias mapping.

devin-ml: the OpenAI tool calling spec is... fuzzy: some clients use alias names for enums. Our compat layer previously accepted `create_item` -> `create`, `rm` -> `delete` etc. That mapping got trimmed to reduce accidental matches.

maria-support: customer needs a short-term workaround while we evaluate: can we accept the alias or provide a mapping on their org config?

ops-sre: we can flip compat mapping per-org behind feature flag `compat:openai_tool_aliases`. I can enable for acme-inc for now. Will that be enough?

paul-support: customer also reported the tool's response shape differed. They expect the tool result to be under `output` but our runtime sent `result`. Example: their webhook consumer fails with `KeyError: 'output'`. Logs show our tool-executor returns `{ "result": {...} }` for legacy tools.

devin-ml: yep two separate mismatches: 1) incoming enum alias, 2) outgoing response field name. We have a per-tool response adapter that can remap `result`->`output`.

maria-support: please capture repro steps I can send to customer support thread. Keep them short.

paul-support: Repro steps for ACME engineer:
1) POST to /v1/responses (hosted) with their tool_calls body (see curl above).
2) Observe 400 with correlation id 6f2a9c11.
3) If using webhook integration, see callback payload has `result` instead of `output`.

paul-support: quick ask: can dev team enable the alias flag for acme-inc and add a temporary response remap? Customer on a PLG tier but revenue-impacting.

ops-sre: enabling org flag now. Will confirm in ~2m.

support-bot: Feature flag `compat:openai_tool_aliases` toggled ON for org acme-inc by ops-sre at 1934567920.

ops-sre: flag is ON. Also added a transient adapter to remap `result`->`output` for tool `inventory_tool`. Deployment id: deploy-rt-2026-03-17-ops-42.

paul-support: pinging customer. will update if they still hit 400. :crossed_fingers:

maria-support: follow-up question for eng: how long until a proper spec mapping/fix ships so we don't keep org-level toggles?

devin-ml: plan: add an OpenAI-compat normalization table into model config (auto-applied for OpenAI-compat models). Target: next patch (v2.3.1) in 3 business days. We'll also add telemetry to catch new aliases.

paul-support: ACME confirmed after flag flip: 200 OK and webhook payload now includes `output` field. They reported latency OK.

maria-support: great. Please file a follow-up ticket to remove the per-org toggle after v2.3.1 ships and add a note to the release changelog about enum normalization.

devin-ml: filed ticket INF-4287: "OpenAI-compat: enum alias normalization + response-field adapters". ETA 3 business days.

paul-support: closing loop with customer. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
